free_text: A biopsy is recommended because the evidence strongly supports further investigation due to the PI-RADS 4 lesion measuring 18 mm and a rising PSA velocity of 0.63 ng/mL/yr. This finding is important, as it contradicts the statistical prior suggesting no biopsy. The decision is driven by the PI-RADS 4 score and the rising PSA trend from 3.1 ng/mL to 3.5 ng/mL over two months, despite the prior positive biopsy.
